answer_1.quote: Boosted by the recent success of deep learning technology, Natural Language Generation (NLG) has recently become popular in the NLP community. Many great works have attempted to solve various subtasks like dialogue generation , poetry generation  and story generation  and new techniques keep emerging .
answer_1.outputs: conditional text outputs such as sentiment-controlled, length-controlled, and topic-controlled text

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the results with two metrics, accuracy and diversity. For accuracy, we train a sentiment classifier and categorical classifier , which could achieve accuracy of 90% and 97% on the validation set, respectively. For diversity, we adopt Distinct-1 and Distinct-2  metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human annotations as a complementary evaluation beyond automatic metrics. Specifically, eight individual judges are asked to rate over 200 conditional samples generated from each model and each condition.
answer_4.guideline: A judge needs to rate fluency and conditionality in the standard 1 to 5 scale. Fluency measures whether the text samples are natural and fluent as real (i.e., human-written) ones. Conditionality indicates whether the generated text adheres to the given condition.
